new.title: Register a policy by hand
new.description: Enter a policy without a PDF: insured, insurer, line and subtype, term, premiums and contacts. You can complete whatever is missing later.

list.subtitle: Every policy of the brokerage, whether it came from a PDF, a hand entry or a full placement.
list.emptyHint: Upload a policy PDF or register one by hand to get started.
list.emptyFilteredHint: Try other filters or clear them to see every policy.

kpi.premiumHint: Gross premium of the policies in force, in UF
kpi.noPlanHint: Live policies without installments: not in Collections
kpi.expiringHint: Review them to renew on time

filters.search: Search by insured, RUT or policy number

missingBlock.title: Missing
missingBlock.subtitle: What is missing for everything to work. Filling it in needs no reason.

complete.hint: Fill in the missing datum. Filling an empty field needs no reason.
complete.premiumsHint: Enter the premiums in the policy currency. Net = taxable + exempt; VAT = 19% of taxable; gross = net + VAT. The server checks they add up.

plan.title: Load payment plan
plan.subtitle: The installments must add up to the gross premium: {{gross}}.
plan.balanced: The installments add up to the gross premium.
plan.unbalanced: The installments do not add up to the gross premium: off by {{diff}}.
plan.error: Could not load the payment plan
plan.needsGross: Complete the gross premium first: the installments must add up to it.
plan.pastDue_one: {{count}} instalment falls due before today ({{today}}): it will be overdue as soon as you save. Check the date if the insurer has not charged it yet.
plan.pastDue_other: {{count}} instalments fall due before today ({{today}}): they will be overdue as soon as you save. Check the dates if the insurer has not charged them yet.
plan.startHint: Radal will send the cadence reminders to the payer from today.
plan.notStartedHint: The plan is loaded with no reminders to the payer. You can start collection later from the collection panel.
plan.startNoPermission: Your role cannot start collection: the plan is loaded with no reminders.
plan.toastStarted: Payment plan loaded and collection started
plan.toastNotStarted: Payment plan loaded. Collection has not started.

party.title: Parties
party.editHint: One policyholder, at least one insured and, if needed, one payer. Third parties keep only name, RUT and contact: they do not become clients.
party.empty: This policy has no parties registered yet.
party.noContact: No email or phone: collections has no one to notify.
party.payerDefault: No payer registered: the policyholder pays.

errors.holder: There must be exactly one policyholder.
errors.insured: There must be at least one insured.
errors.payer: There can be at most one payer.
errors.name: Every party needs a name.

fieldErrors.name: Enter the name.
fieldErrors.rut: This RUT is not valid: check the check digit.

collectionBlock.title: Collections
collectionBlock.noPlan: This policy has no installments: it is not in Collections and raises no due-date notices.

journeyBlock.title: Journey
journeyBlock.empty: This policy did not go through placement stages.
journeyBlock.viewerHint: The placement shows only the stages that happened and their files.

clientPicker.placeholder: Search a client by name or RUT
clientPicker.error: We could not search clients. Try again.

upload.noTarget: Choose the subtype before uploading the PDF.
upload.subtypeHint: The policy is filed in that line's placement; if there is none, one is created.
upload.subtypeFirst: Pick the line and subtype first
upload.clientHint: Leave it blank to use the RUT read from the PDF.
upload.unresolvedTitle: We do not know which insured this policy belongs to
upload.pickClient: Or pick a client from the book

progress.title: Reading the policy…
progress.hint: We read the main data first: insured, period, premium and instalments. It usually takes 10 to 20 seconds.

technical.reading: Reading technical data… (it will appear on the policy for review)
technical.failed: The technical data could not be read. You can retry from the policy.
technical.ready: Technical data read: review and confirm it on the policy.

upload.lost: The read took longer than expected and no answer arrived. Check the policy list before retrying: it may already be registered.

insurer.title: Which insurer issued this policy?
insurer.noName: The PDF does not show the insurer's name.
insurer.reasonFallback: The policy shows neither the insurer's RUT nor its CMF code. Pick the insurer that issued it.
insurer.label: Insurer
insurer.empty: There are no insurers to pick from.
insurer.onlySuggestions: Your role cannot see every insurer: pick one of the suggestions.
insurer.notFound: The selected insurer is no longer available. Pick another one.

duplicate.message: This policy already exists: No. {{number}} from {{insurer}}.
duplicate.hint: Nothing new was recorded: no other policy, cuotas, alerts or technical read.

sections.insuredHint: The RUT rules: if it is already in the book, that insured is used.
sections.premiumsHint: Optional. With the gross premium you can load the payment plan later; taxable and exempt premiums feed the reports.
sections.partiesHint: Collections goes to the policyholder. By default it is the insured, and the policyholder pays.

hints.insuredRut: With or without dots; the check digit is validated.
hints.policyNumber: Optional. Without a number the policy cannot be endorsed.
hints.paymentMethod: Optional. Suggested when loading the payment plan.
hints.isProvisional: Charged in advance and adjusted later with what is declared.
hints.total: Optional. Switches on the payment plan and collections.
hints.commission: Optional. Adds to the estimated commission.
hints.contact: Collection notices go to this email.

preview.mismatch: The gross premium entered does not match net + VAT.

errors.endBeforeStart: The term end must be after the start.
errors.subtype: Choose the subtype. If the line has only one, it is selected when you pick the line.
errors.ambiguous: Ambiguous amount: use a comma for decimals (12,345) or type it without dots (12345).
errors.totalMismatch: The gross premium does not match net + VAT. Fix it or leave it blank to derive it.

noPermission.plan: Your role cannot create payment plans.
noPermission.share: Your role cannot share this policy.
noPermission.cases: Your role cannot view case folders.

technical.title: Technical data read by AI
technical.suggestion: Read by AI — Review and confirm
technical.readingHint: Items, coverages, deductibles, warranties, exclusions and clauses. It usually takes under a minute; you can keep working.
technical.readyHint: Review what was read. Nothing is saved to the policy until you confirm.
technical.readyHintAt: Read on {{when}}. Nothing is saved to the policy until you confirm.
technical.noneHint: Read the items, coverages, deductibles, warranties, exclusions and clauses from the PDF to review and confirm them.
technical.noPermission: Your role cannot read or confirm policy technical data
technical.noPdf: The policy has no PDF; upload it to read the technical data
technical.noExtraction: The read reference is missing; reload the page

errors.ai_timeout: The read took longer than expected. Retry; if it persists, let us know.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI provider is unavailable. Retry in a few minutes.
errors.ai_parse: The AI answered something we could not interpret. Retry.
errors.generic: The technical read could not be completed.

technical.empty: We found no technical data in the PDF (items, coverages, deductibles, warranties, exclusions or clauses). You can discard this reading.

pastInstallments.title_one: This policy has {{count}} cuota already past due ({{amount}}). Has it been paid?
pastInstallments.title_other: This policy has {{count}} cuotas already past due ({{amount}}). Have they been paid?
pastInstallments.titleNoAmount_one: This policy has {{count}} cuota already past due. Has it been paid?
pastInstallments.titleNoAmount_other: This policy has {{count}} cuotas already past due. Have they been paid?
pastInstallments.titleUnknown: This policy has cuotas already past due. Have they been paid?
pastInstallments.hint: Until you decide, those cuotas raise no termination alerts and do not count as overdue in Collections.
pastInstallments.doneUnpaid: The cuotas stay overdue; alerts resume
pastInstallments.noPermission: Your role cannot register collection payments
pastInstallments.noPlan: We could not find this policy's payment plan
pastInstallments.error: Your answer could not be saved
